$comment: Dead by Daylight realms and maps. 'names' maps a game language code to the text shown on the loading screen. Localized names adapted from dbd-map-overlay by Luca Fontanot (Apache-2.0), see THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md. To add your own maps or languages without rebuilding, put a file with the same structure named custom-maps.json in the AutoReShade data folder. 'readyButton' and 'continueButton' are the texts of the lobby's Ready button and the results screen's Continue button per game language; seeing either means the match is over.
